CORE MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 9

2. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

3. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 156
   D. 48

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 22
   C. 15
   D. 30

5. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 12x

6. Solve for x: x + 4 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 4
   C. 8
   D. 7

7. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 32
   C. 33
   D. 12

8. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

9. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 12

10. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 12.5
   C. 5
   D. 25

11. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

12. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 72
   C. 1
   D. 73

13. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 21
   C. 1
   D. 9

14. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 5

15. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 2/2
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/4

16. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 2
   C. 25
   D. 24

17. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 36

18. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 13
   C. 17
   D. 7

19. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x ≥ 0 only
   B. x = 5
   C. x > 5
   D. x < 5

20. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 2

21. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 1
   C. 56
   D. 15

22. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.6
   C. 29
   D. 23.7

23. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.7
   C. 27.6
   D. 33

24. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 60
   B. 30
   C. 38
   D. 19

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
